Gurugram Luxury Real Estate Sees Drop in New Launches Amid High-Value Deal

Gurugram experienced a 28% decrease in luxury real estate launches during the first half of 2026. This trend occurred alongside a record-setting deal where a penthouse was sold for Rs 271 crore. The high-value transaction has been cited as setting a new benchmark for the Indian luxury housing market.
